name: The Joker
about: Gradient-boosted trees (binomial deviance, depth 4, 25 rounds, learning rate 0.1, at least 5 games a leaf) on every number the job has before tip-off: the market's moneyline chance, line and total, Team Elo, the player model on the previous game's lineup, rest, back to backs, travel, altitude, each side's running efficiency and pace, and the teams. Fitted on 2022-23 to 2025-26 and never refitted in the job; a game with no moneyline posted gets no call.
